boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Loyola University Maryland
boards.description: Ten current campus food destinations with published evening or overnight availability.

cards.title: Iggy's Market
cards.subtitle: Newman Towers, west side of campus
cards.notes: Use this Newman Towers market when you need food later in the evening; confirm the day’s dining schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus market with midnight closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Iggy's Market in Newman Towers and publishes hours ending at 12:00 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Iggy's Market | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Mon–Fri 7:30 a.m.–12:00 a.m.; Sat–Sun 9:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m.

cards.title: Fresh West
cards.subtitle: Loyola campus
cards.notes: Place a mobile order before the 9:30 p.m. weekday close, then use the listed pickup option for a campus dinner run.
cards.short_summary: Weekday Latin-inspired food available until 9:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes Fresh West as an idealMEAL location and lists Monday–Friday hours until 9:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Fresh West | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Friday 11:00 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; closed Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Boulder Garden Café
cards.subtitle: Andrew White Student Center
cards.notes: Head to the Andrew White Student Center for dinner service; check whether weekday or weekend hours apply before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: The student-center dining hall serves dinner through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola locates Boulder Garden Café in the Andrew White Student Center and lists dinner ending at 9 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: Boulder Garden Café | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published dinner hours: Mon–Fri 5:00–9:00 p.m.; Sat–Sun 3:00–9:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Just Walk Out Express Store at Thea Bowman Hall
cards.title: Just Walk Out at Thea Bowman Hall
cards.subtitle: Thea Bowman Hall, Loyola campus
cards.notes: Use the Thea Bowman Hall express store for packaged and prepared food; enter with the published app or payment method.
cards.short_summary: An overnight-style campus express store open until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists a Just Walk Out Express Store in Thea Bowman Hall and publishes store hours of 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Just Walk Out Express Stores | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Sunday, 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.

cards.entity_name: Just Walk Out Express Store at Sellinger School of Business & Management
cards.title: Just Walk Out at Sellinger
cards.subtitle: Sellinger School of Business & Management, Loyola campus
cards.notes: For a late snack near Sellinger, use the express-store entry process and take only items you intend to purchase.
cards.short_summary: Sellinger’s express-store location runs until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies the Sellinger School of Business & Management as a Just Walk Out Express Store location and lists daily hours until 2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Just Walk Out Express Stores | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Sunday, 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.

cards.entity_name: Just Walk Out Express Store at Fitness & Aquatics Center
cards.title: Just Walk Out at the FAC
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatics Center, Loyola campus
cards.notes: Stop at the FAC express store for prepared food or snacks, using the posted payment-entry method before the 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: The FAC express store offers late access to food and drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies the Fitness & Aquatics Center as a Just Walk Out Express Store location and publishes daily hours ending at 2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Just Walk Out Express Stores | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Sunday, 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.

cards.title: Boulder 2.0
cards.subtitle: Andrew White Student Center
cards.notes: Use this separate student-center counter for an early-evening weekday meal and check its shorter Friday schedule before you go.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Andrew White Student Center option open until 8 p.m. weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola locates Boulder 2.0 in the Andrew White Student Center and lists Monday–Thursday hours until 8:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Boulder 2.0 | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Thursday 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; Friday 11:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

cards.title: Choolaah Indian BBQ
cards.subtitle: Loyola campus
cards.notes: Plan a weekday dinner at this campus bowl counter; the university lists vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options alongside its hours.
cards.short_summary: Customizable campus bowls are available until 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Choolaah Indian BBQ’s Monday–Thursday hours as 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Choolaah Indian BBQ | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Thursday 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; Friday until 5:00 p.m.; closed weekends.

cards.title: Humanities Café
cards.subtitle: Humanities Center, Loyola campus
cards.notes: Use the Humanities Center café for a weekday dessert or drink run before its listed 8 p.m. close; Friday ends earlier.
cards.short_summary: Campus café with ice cream, crepes, boba, and an 8 p.m. weekday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Humanities Café’s Monday–Thursday operating hours as 12:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Humanities Cafe | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Monday–Thursday 12:00–8:00 p.m.; Friday 11:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Starbucks Café at Loyola University Maryland
cards.title: Starbucks Café
cards.subtitle: Loyola campus
cards.notes: For a food or nonalcoholic coffee stop, check the weekday-versus-weekend schedule; the café is listed through 8 p.m. on select days.
cards.short_summary: Loyola’s full-service Starbucks stays open until 8 p.m. on multiple days.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists Starbucks Café hours until 8:00 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Starbucks | Dining Services | Loyola University Maryland
cards.access_notes: Published normal hours: Mon–Thu 7:30 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; Sun 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; earlier on Friday and Saturday.
